# opencode-extra

Extra plugins for [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai).

## `pread` — Parallel File Reading

Read multiple files **simultaneously** instead of one-by-one.

**Before:** 10 files = 10 sequential reads = 10x slower  
**After:** 10 files = 1 parallel call = instant

```typescript
{
  files: [
    { path: "/project/src/main.ts", limit: 50 },
    { path: "/project/package.json" }
  ]
}
```

## Installation

```bash
npm install @yumeguru/opencode-extra
```

Then add to your `opencode.json`:

```json
{
  "plugins": ["@yumeguru/opencode-extra"]
}
```
